chore: group public and private imports (#44512)

Group public imports before private imports, with a blank line between the groups, in 2,076 Mathlib files. Preserve the order within each group, import modifiers, and comments. No imports are removed or have their visibility changed.

Generated using the formatter in #44503. This is a source-only cleanup and can merge independently of the linter implementation.

Supersedes #42063.
